raw_pages.raw_text:
(Crl. Appeal: 07/2021)
16      15.07.2024
Today is fixed for S/R of notice upon 
respondent No.2.
No S/R is received. 
On perusal of the case record it appears 
that no requisites upon respondent No.2 have 
been filed. 
Learned advocate for the appellant files 
petition praying for time to file the requisites.  
Heard both sides. Case is adjourned today
on the prayer of the learned advocate for the 
appellant. However, appellant is directed to file 
the requisite at once. 
Fix 19.08.2024 for filing requisites upon 
respondent No.2.
Dictated & corrected by me
`
               Ss.J
                                        Sessions  Judge
